units.source_text: 不杀了男人——当然，只要能霸占这女人，我没想着要杀了他。

en.t: Not kill the man, of course; as long as I could take possession of the woman, I had no intention of killing him.

units.source_text: 然而当我准备扔下趴在地上痛苦的女人往竹林外逃窜的时候，那个女人突然疯狂的抓住了我的胳膊。

en.t: But just as I was about to leave the woman lying on the ground in pain and flee out of the bamboo grove, she suddenly grabbed my arm like a madwoman.

units.source_text: 她抽抽噎噎的喊道，“你也好，我丈夫也好，你们俩必须得死一个。

en.t: Sobbing, she cried out, Whether it is you or my husband, one of you two has to die.

units.source_text: 在两个男人眼前出丑，我生不如死。”

en.t: After being shamed before two men, I would rather die than live.

units.source_text: 最后她有气喘吁吁的说了句，“你们两个中间，谁活下来，我就跟谁。”

en.t: At last, gasping for breath, she said, Whichever one of you survives, I will go with him.

units.source_text: 这个时候我才突然想杀死那个男人的。

en.t: Only then did I suddenly want to kill that man.
